abstract.para: Allow the &rmt; server to reach &scc; when it is located behind a firewall that does not support host name allowlisting.

topic.para: If the firewall you are using does not support host name allowlisting—such as &firewalld;—you need to allow connections to the corresponding IP addresses as described in the following steps.

step.para: Resolve the IP address of the domain, for example, installer-updates.suse.com.
Add firewall rules for ports 80 and 443 for each discovered IP address.
step.screen: &prompt.sudo;firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public \ --add-rich-rule='rule family="ipv4" source address="152.199.22.115" \ port protocol="tcp" port="80" accept'
&prompt.sudo;firewall-cmd --permanent --zone=public \ --add-rich-rule='rule family="ipv4" source address="152.199.22.115" \ port protocol="tcp" port="443" accept'
